verdict.rationale: KYB is a fair axis for an AML/compliance platform, so it applies here. The evidence only shows that a customer record can be a company, which can then be screened against sanctions, PEP and adverse-media lists. That is watchlist screening, an adjacent capability, not KYB: there is no evidence of company registry lookups, UBO identification, or KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can verify businesses, not just people — registry lookups, UBO identification, and documented KYB flows that chain into KYC on the owners
